feature_title: Logs Index Stream Change Resets Pagination

rationale.edition: The only changed path is web/src/plugins/logs/IndexList.vue, which lives in the open-source web frontend tree. No paths fall under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/, and no enterprise keywords (cipher, SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, etc.) appear in the path or the changed code, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No explicit opt-out is present (trigger_comment and feature_hint are empty, no tests-added label indicated), and the change is user-facing rather than docs/CI-only: it alters the logs index view's pagination behavior.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff adds a deep watcher on searchObj.data.stream.selectedStream that calls resetPagination(), so switching streams now resets the logs list back to page 1 in both regular and SQL Mode. That is a user-exercisable interaction that should be verified in the browser.
rationale.area: Logs. The changed file is the logs index list component under web/src/plugins/logs/, and the behavior (stream selection + pagination in the logs table) belongs to the Logs product area where sibling specs already live.
rationale.group: Logs-Core. This shard (actual_folder Logs) already contains the closest related specs such as pagination.spec.js and logspage.spec.js, so the new stream-change pagination-reset spec fits naturally there.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only changed file is a web/src Vue component (web/src/plugins/logs/IndexList.vue); there are no Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so existing_tests_in_diff is false.
